title: Centrifuge Metro
content: I just saw this community on my home page and I am stoked it exists. I haven’t been to this place in a while but for a few years I would visit it and would love to know if anyone else ever has. It was a very densely populated city that had this metro system that rose up above it. There were only four short tracks made of cement for this metro spaced very far apart from each other in sort of a circle around the city. It seemed to work like a centrifuge. The train cars would fly from one track to another. The first time I went there it terrified me. I got used to it though. I’ve been to a few dream cities repeatedly but this one got very familiar very quickly. I always knew how to get to where I was going, which is not a common dream occurrence for me. Happy dreaming!
